q: What does FlashAttention change about attention?
options: It computes exact attention in tiles without storing the full score matrix
explain: IO-aware tiling with an online softmax.

q: What does “lost in the middle” describe?
options: Models using information at the start and end of long inputs better than in the middle

q: Which cost still grows quadratically with FlashAttention?
explain: Memory becomes linear; compute stays quadratic.
